craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of the sealed proof — utsāha as each consequence collapses and the maker stands. Mercy-betrays-passion; own-view-laid-bare close. Rejected: (a) mercy→pity → killed: mercy acts. Read aloud: THE-know-ER ACTS from-MER-cy-STILL … YOUR-own-VIEW laid-BARE.

lines: The knower acts from mercy still — yet were no passion there,
release is passion's waning: your own view laid bare.

reads_against.argmap: Mercy-acts — passionless? → Compassion smuggles passion back; the view becomes passion-exhaustion doctrine.
c1_essence: The svabhāva-view's consequences pressed: desired-by-all yet body-changes by nature; occurrence without union; needlessness fitting neither spirit nor mind; no reunion yet rebirth; mokṣa collapsed into nature; compassion-acts forcing passion-exhaustion doctrine (vv46-51).
The siddhānta sealed: nature-view abandoned as unjust, bodies famously sentient-maker-prior, arrangement-difference the flawless proof, the hetu aimed at Parameśvara unshaken (vv52-54).
